items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I used to play all his father's arrangements because the shows would come through there and they would have on there, arranged by Eddie Heywood Hayward 81 Theater.

ctx.x: Well, that's what I'm speaking about.

I met -- fortunately, I met his father. Well, now, his father -- I used to play all his father's arrangements because the shows would come through there and they would have on there, arranged by Eddie Heywood Hayward 81 Theater. He played at the 81 Theater, in Atlanta.
